title: PF2e: Symphonies of War
description: Foundry VTT implementation of the Virtuoso class and Symphonies of War content for Pathfinder Second Edition.

acoustic-wind.label: Acoustic (Wind)
acoustic-wind.description: Weapons and shields with this trait are masterfully crafted to double as musical instruments. Every acoustic item specifies its instrument category: Percussion, String, or Wind. You can use an acoustic item as a handheld musical instrument. If a feature or ability requires you to hold a musical instrument, wielding an acoustic item in the required number of hands satisfies this requirement. If a shield with the acoustic trait has an attached weapon, that weapon also gains the same acoustic trait as the shield.
